claims.text: NuGet's packages.lock.json records, per target framework, every package in the full closure, direct and transitive, with its resolved version and a contentHash of the package; entries carry a type such as Direct or Transitive.
claims.source_hint: NuGet docs: PackageReference in project files > Locking dependencies; packages.lock.json format

claims.text: Setting RestorePackagesWithLockFile to true makes restore create and use packages.lock.json in the project folder; NuGet advises committing it for applications and executables at the start of the dependency chain.
claims.source_hint: NuGet docs: PackageReference in project files > Locking dependencies > Enabling the lock file; Make lock file part of your source repository

claims.text: dotnet restore --locked-mode fails, instead of updating the lock file, when the project's dependencies would resolve to anything packages.lock.json does not record; restore without locked mode updates packages.lock.json after the dependencies change.
claims.source_hint: NuGet docs: Locking dependencies > locked mode (RestoreLockedMode, NU1004); dotnet restore --locked-mode ('Don't allow updating project lock file')

claims.text: When restoring with a lock file, NuGet checks each package against the contentHash recorded in packages.lock.json and fails on a mismatch (error NU1403).
claims.source_hint: NuGet docs: Errors and warnings NU1403 (package content hash validation failed); Locking dependencies

claims.text: pubspec.lock records, for each package from a hosted source, its exact version and a sha256 content hash (SDK packages have none); DonHang.App/pubspec.lock exists from stage-2.
claims.source_hint: Dart docs: pub glossary (lockfile), dart pub get; examples/don-hang @ stage-2 DonHang.App/pubspec.lock

claims.text: flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile fails if pubspec.lock does not exactly give a valid resolution of pubspec.yaml or if a downloaded hosted package's content hash differs from the one recorded.
claims.source_hint: Dart docs: dart pub get --enforce-lockfile option (flutter pub get passes it through)

claims.text: Without a lock file, pub get resolves the newest package versions that the pubspec.yaml constraints allow, so a fresh clone can get newer versions than an earlier resolution.
claims.source_hint: Dart docs: dart pub get (uses lockfile if present, otherwise resolves latest compatible versions); Package dependencies
